continuity_scope: Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition setting witness: Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide, as the official D&D Beyond source page published 27 June 2017. This is a 5e Sword Coast/Faerûn reference-product pass, not a generic Forgotten Realms continuity, novel, video-game, streaming, or adaptation census.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Official D&D Beyond Fifth Edition digital source page, published 27 June 2017.
Official D&D Beyond marketplace product, SKU SRC-00013; product-scope metadata.
Official current errata page; confirms recent printings differ in wording.

coverage_rule: Terms-only audit. The selected official setting product has no fixed named dramatic cast in the accessible witness, so no character or relationship records are made. Include only four setting-native scope terms directly named in the official table of contents/product description. Places, factions, setting categories, and generic D&D options remain terms; none become character nodes.
omissions: All named Forgotten Realms characters, including novel, adventure, game, comics, and adaptation casts; they require separate exact-work witnesses.
All player characters, since table-created characters are not fixed canonical individuals in this setting sourcebook.
All editions other than the declared 5e D&D Beyond source witness, including retconned or contradictory era material and recent-printing changes beyond this terms-only scope.
Generic D&D ancestries, classes, spells, deities, monsters, items, planes, and rules; they are not automatically Forgotten Realms-specific merely because the book contains related options.
uncertainties: This pass intentionally does not reconcile Realms chronology or retcons across editions. The official errata page shows that even this product has revised wording in recent printings.
The accessible official page exposes table-of-contents and product-scope evidence, not a licensed full text for claim-level named-character records.
Published settings, novels, games, and adaptations are distinct continuities/witnesses. The broad Forgotten Realms label should never be used to merge them automatically.
evidence_basis: D&D Beyond presents Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide as an official Dungeons & Dragons campaign sourcebook and identifies its sections on Toril, Sword Coast, the Lords' Alliance, and Realms religion/magic. The official marketplace page frames it as Forgotten Realms Sword Coast material, while official errata documents edition/printing variability. No wiki or user forum material is used.

citations.locator: Source landing page, campaign-sourcebook description and Contents: Chapters 1-2
supports: Official product identity and terms Toril, Sword Coast and the North, Lords' Alliance, magic, and religion in the Realms.

supports: Wizards of the Coast publisher, Forgotten Realms/Sword Coast scope, places/cultures/deities focus, and generic game-option distinction.
